check_constraints.check:
ownership_epoch >= 0 AND assistant_epoch >= 0 AND binding_epoch >= 0 AND control_epoch >= 0 AND
claim_generation >= 0 AND attempt_count >= 0 AND watermark >= 0 AND regroup_count BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND
state IN ('queued', 'running', 'retry_wait', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'superseded', 'failed') AND
(state = 'running') = (lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL) AND
(state = 'retry_wait') = (retry_at IS NOT NULL) AND
(state = 'completed') = (decision IS NOT NULL) AND
(state IN ('completed', 'cancelled', 'superseded', 'failed')) = (finished_at IS NOT NULL)
check_constraints.name: support_runs_lifecycle

check_constraints.check:
(CASE
  WHEN jsonb_typeof(typed_decision->'reply_text') = 'string' THEN
    state = 'completed' AND retention_state IN ('present', 'held')
    AND typed_decision->>'decision' IN ('answer_grounded', 'clarify')
    AND (retention_state <> 'held' OR retention_occurrence IS NOT NULL)
  WHEN retention_state = 'purged' THEN
    state = 'completed' AND retention_occurrence IS NOT NULL
    AND typed_decision->>'decision' IN ('answer_grounded', 'clarify')
    AND NOT (typed_decision ? 'reply_text')
  ELSE retention_state IS NULL AND retention_occurrence IS NULL
    AND typed_decision->>'decision' IS DISTINCT FROM 'answer_grounded'
    AND (typed_decision IS NULL OR typed_decision ? 'reply_text')
END) IS TRUE
check_constraints.name: support_runs_reply_retention

check_constraints.check:
NOT assisted_draft OR (state = 'completed' AND decision = 'no_send'
  AND (retention_state = 'purged' OR
    (shadow_disposition = 'no_send' AND evidence_refs IS NOT NULL))) IS TRUE
check_constraints.name: support_runs_assisted_provenance

check_constraints.check:
CASE
  WHEN typed_decision IS NULL THEN
    decision IS DISTINCT FROM 'typed_reply' AND
    shadow_disposition IS NULL AND evidence_refs IS NULL AND context_digest IS NULL
  WHEN state <> 'completed' OR claim_generation <= 0 OR
    jsonb_typeof(typed_decision) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN false
  WHEN evidence_refs IS NULL THEN
    context_digest IS NULL AND decision = 'no_send' AND coalesce(
      (shadow_disposition = 'local_handoff' AND typed_decision->>'decision' = 'handoff')
      OR (shadow_disposition = 'no_send' AND typed_decision->>'decision' IN ('greeting', 'clarify', 'decline')),
      false)
  ELSE coalesce(
    context_digest ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND
    cardinality(evidence_refs) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND array_position(evidence_refs, NULL) IS NULL AND
    ((decision = 'no_send' AND shadow_disposition = 'no_send') OR
      (decision = 'typed_reply' AND shadow_disposition IS NULL)) AND
    ((typed_decision->>'decision' = 'answer_exact' AND cardinality(evidence_refs) = 1) OR
      typed_decision->>'decision' = 'answer_grounded'),
    false)
END
check_constraints.name: support_runs_typed_completion

custom_statements.name: guard_shadow_completion_function
guard_shadow_completion_trigger
custom_statements.up:
CREATE TRIGGER support_runs_immutable_shadow_completion
  BEFORE UPDATE OF typed_decision, shadow_disposition ON support_runs
  FOR EACH ROW
  WHEN (OLD.state <> 'running' AND
    (OLD.typed_decision IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.typed_decision OR
     OLD.shadow_disposition IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.shadow_disposition)
   AND NEW.retention_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'purged')
  EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_support_run_shadow_completion();

custom_statements.name: guard_reply_retention_function
custom_statements.up:
CREATE FUNCTION guard_support_run_reply_retention() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
  IF OLD.retention_state IS NULL AND OLD.state = 'running'
      AND NEW.state = 'completed' AND NEW.retention_state = 'present'
      AND NEW.retention_occurrence IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF OLD.state = 'completed'
      AND ((OLD.retention_state = 'present' AND NEW.retention_state IN ('held', 'purged'))
        OR (OLD.retention_state = 'held' AND NEW.retention_state IN ('present', 'purged')))
      AND NEW.retention_occurrence IS NOT NULL
      AND OLD.retention_occurrence IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.retention_occurrence
      AND (to_jsonb(OLD) - ARRAY['retention_state','retention_occurrence','typed_decision','updated_at'])
        = (to_jsonb(NEW) - ARRAY['retention_state','retention_occurrence','typed_decision','updated_at'])
      AND NEW.typed_decision = (CASE WHEN NEW.retention_state = 'purged'
        THEN OLD.typed_decision - 'reply_text'
        ELSE OLD.typed_decision END) THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid reply retention transition' USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
END
$$;

custom_statements.name: guard_reply_retention_trigger
custom_statements.up:
CREATE TRIGGER support_runs_reply_retention_transition
  BEFORE UPDATE ON support_runs FOR EACH ROW
  WHEN (OLD.retention_state IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.retention_state
    OR OLD.retention_occurrence IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.retention_occurrence
    OR (OLD.retention_state IS NOT NULL AND OLD.typed_decision IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.typed_decision)
    OR (OLD.retention_state IS NOT NULL AND OLD.finished_at IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.finished_at))
  EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_support_run_reply_retention();

custom_statements.name: guard_typed_completion
custom_statements.up:
CREATE TRIGGER support_runs_immutable_typed_completion
  BEFORE UPDATE OF decision, evidence_refs, context_digest, claim_generation,
    session_id, assistant_revision_id, ownership_epoch, assistant_epoch,
    binding_epoch, control_epoch, watermark, deadline_at ON support_runs
  FOR EACH ROW
  WHEN (OLD.state = 'completed' AND OLD.typed_decision IS NOT NULL AND (
    ROW(OLD.decision, OLD.evidence_refs, OLD.context_digest, OLD.claim_generation,
        OLD.session_id, OLD.assistant_revision_id, OLD.ownership_epoch, OLD.assistant_epoch,
        OLD.binding_epoch, OLD.control_epoch, OLD.watermark, OLD.deadline_at)
    IS DISTINCT FROM
    ROW(NEW.decision, NEW.evidence_refs, NEW.context_digest, NEW.claim_generation,
        NEW.session_id, NEW.assistant_revision_id, NEW.ownership_epoch, NEW.assistant_epoch,
        NEW.binding_epoch, NEW.control_epoch, NEW.watermark, NEW.deadline_at)))
  EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_support_run_shadow_completion();
